episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Jimmy Keene is living in the fast lane—until he gets a 10-year prison sentence. Behind bars, he's approached about a high-stakes deal for freedom.

episodes.title: We Are Coming, Father Abraham
episodes.summary: Agent McCauley prepares Jimmy for the mission. Detective Miller questions Larry about the missing women, leading to a polygraph test.

episodes.title: Hand to Mouth
episodes.summary: Struggling with his transition to maximum security prison, Jimmy initiates a friendship with Larry. New holes in Larry's stories are uncovered.

episodes.title: WhatsHerName
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of a prison riot, Jimmy and Larry find themselves with time to learn more about each other.

episodes.title: The Place I Lie
episodes.summary: Jimmy's mounting fear and paranoia compel him to provoke Larry. McCauley and Miller have a breakthrough. Larry's therapist grows concerned.

episodes.title: You Promised
episodes.summary: Series finale. Jimmy reaches his breaking point. Larry becomes suspicious. McCauley and Miller talk to an important person in Larry's life.
